How to play Freeze Dance Improv

Dance. Freeze. Become a character. Music plays, everyone dances. When it stops, freeze. The host calls out a character or emotion — everyone must instantly act as that character until the music restarts.

2–10 players~10 minHigh Energy & WildActing & performance games

How to play

  1. Play music and everyone dances (or just moves around).
  2. Host stops the music unexpectedly — everyone freezes immediately.
  3. Host calls a character or emotion ('terrified accountant', 'robot in love').
  4. Everyone acts as that character until the music starts again.
  5. Switch it up every round — more specific character = more fun.

Example round

  • Freeze! 'You're a medieval knight discovering a smartphone.'
  • Freeze! 'You're a golden retriever at its first job interview.'
  • Freeze! 'You just found out you won an Oscar but also spilled soup on yourself.'

Tips

  • Combine two incompatible things for the best characters: profession + emotional state.
  • Let the freeze last 20–30 seconds so everyone can fully commit.
